add.label: Link to a GitHub project
add.placeholder: Paste a GitHub link, like github.com/owner/project

empty.title: Run projects from GitHub — no setup needed
empty.body: Paste a link to a project on GitHub above. Repo Launcher downloads it, sets up everything it needs, and starts it for you.

step.createEnvironment: Creating a private space for this project

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: This deletes the project and everything Repo Launcher installed for it. Anything the project saved inside its own folder is deleted too.

INVALID_LINK.title: That doesn't look like a GitHub link.

NOT_GITHUB.title: Repo Launcher works with projects on GitHub.
NOT_GITHUB.body: Paste a link that starts with github.com.

REPO_NOT_FOUND_OR_PRIVATE.title: We couldn't find {{repo}}.
REPO_NOT_FOUND_OR_PRIVATE.body: The link may be mistyped, or the project may be private. Opening private projects will be possible after connecting your GitHub account.

RATE_LIMITED.title: GitHub asked us to slow down.
RATE_LIMITED.body: Please try again in about {{minutes}} minutes.

OFFLINE.title: You seem to be offline.
OFFLINE.body: Check your internet connection, then try again.

DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: The download didn't finish.
DOWNLOAD_FAILED.body: This is usually temporary. Try again in a moment.

DOWNLOAD_CORRUPT.title: A download was damaged on the way.
DOWNLOAD_CORRUPT.body: We threw it away to keep your computer safe. Try again.

UNSUPPORTED_PROJECT.title: Repo Launcher can't run this kind of project yet.
UNSUPPORTED_PROJECT.body: It looks like a {{ecosystem}} project. Support for more kinds of projects is on the way.

NO_ENTRY_POINT.title: We couldn't tell how to start this project.
NO_ENTRY_POINT.body: It may be a library or a collection of files rather than an app you can open.

MANIFEST_INVALID.title: This project's setup file has a mistake.
MANIFEST_INVALID.body: Its launcher.json couldn't be used. Copy the diagnostics and share them with the project's author.

MISSING_SYSTEM_TOOL.title: This project needs “{{tool}}”, which isn't on this computer.
MISSING_SYSTEM_TOOL.body: Install {{tool}} using its official installer, then try again.

INSTALL_STEP_FAILED.title: Setup didn't finish.
INSTALL_STEP_FAILED.body: One of the setup steps stopped with an error. Trying again often helps. If it doesn't, copy the diagnostics and share them with the project's author.

NEEDS_COMPILER.title: This project needs extra developer tools.
NEEDS_COMPILER.body: It builds part of itself on your computer, which needs free tools from your system's maker. Install them, then try again.

NOT_INSTALLED.title: This project isn't installed yet.
NOT_INSTALLED.body: Install it first, then launch it.

ALREADY_RUNNING.title: It's already running.
ALREADY_RUNNING.body: Use Open to see it, or Stop to close it.

LAUNCH_FAILED.title: The project couldn't start.
LAUNCH_FAILED.body: Installing it again usually fixes this.

EXITED_EARLY.title: The project stopped right after starting.
EXITED_EARLY.body: Check its activity to see what it said before stopping.
EXITED_EARLY.bodyModule: It's missing a part called “{{module}}”. Installing it again usually fixes this.

START_TIMEOUT.title: The project is taking a long time to start.
START_TIMEOUT.body: It may still be getting ready. Stop it and try again if nothing happens.

CANCELLED.title: Installation cancelled.
CANCELLED.body: You can install it again whenever you like.

PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.title: That project isn't in your library anymore.

INTERNAL.title: Something went wrong on our side.
INTERNAL.body: Try again. If it keeps happening, copy the diagnostics and report it.
